amendments.reason: A permissive, OSI-approved licence carried by the four packages the runtime graph reaches through glob under @fastify/static, a pinned row of the closed dependency inventory, so the row cannot be removed without departing from that inventory.

developmentOnlyExceptions.reason: Permitted by the request for development-only dependencies; a package carrying it MUST NOT appear in a runtime graph.

source: Success criteria 11 fixes the licence list this gate applies — MIT, ISC, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0 and 0BSD, with MPL-2.0 permitted for development-only dependencies. Every licence this data file admits beyond that list is recorded below as an amendment naming the licence and why the tree needs it, and every development-only exception carries its own reason; widening either set is a reviewable diff to this file.
